concern: **Concern note:** `/workspace/mcp.json` has no credential, and an unauthenticated request gets a 401. I passed `MCP_SERVER_TOKEN` with `--access-token` instead. I did not edit the config, because I did not want to write the secret to disk. The `mcpjam` binary isn't installed either, so I ran it through `npx @mcpjam/cli`. I did not use the MCPJam account API (cloud), because the checks didn't need it. Nothing needs the account owner.
